name: SeePhys
description: We present SeePhys, a large-scale multimodal benchmark for LLM reasoning grounded in physics questions ranging from middle school to PhD qualifying exams. The benchmark covers 7 fundamental domains spanning the physics discipline, incorporating 21 categories of highly heterogeneous diagrams. In contrast to prior works where visual elements mainly serve auxiliary purposes, our benchmark features a substantial proportion of vision-essential problems (75%) that mandate visual information extraction for correct solutions.
reputation: A recent physics reasoning benchmark that is notable for emphasizing vision-essential problems and broad coverage across physics subfields.
notes: Contains many diagram-heavy questions and a high fraction of vision-essential items; likely sensitive to model OCR/diagram parsing and may have limited long-term leaderboard saturation.
